verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev's versioning docs say a run is locked to the latest code version for its environment when it starts and never changes versions, even after new deploys. Its checkpoint-resume model runs plain TypeScript with no determinism constraints, so new deploys cannot break in-flight replay. Deploys are documented via the CLI and GitHub Actions, and durable chat tasks are described as surviving deploys. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that in-flight runs stay pinned across deploys.
